validator.source_text:
<?ui-args --data-model-package datamodels/example/package/example.data-model.json?>
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" xmlns:datamodel="https://github.com/stateforward/scxml.rs/namespaces/datamodel" version="1.0" datamodel="exampel" datamodel:src="https://github.com/stateforward/scxml.rs/datamodels/example" initial="a">
  <state id="a">
    <transition event="go" target="done"/>
  </state>
  <final id="done"/>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: the data model is `exampel`, but its package names it `example`
notes: the `datamodel` token names the data model the machine's expressions are written in, and the package `datamodel:src` names declares which one it implements; they must agree
diagnostics.help: write `datamodel="example"`, or name the package of `exampel`
